description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for managing active dashboard filters in a Superset frontend application, including functions to get active filters, apply filters to charts, and build filter states.

methods.name: getActiveFilters
methods.description: Returns the current active filters object.

methods.name: getAppliedFilterValues
methods.description: Retrieves the filter values applied to a specific chart, utilizing caching for performance.

methods.name: getChartIdsInFilterScope
methods.description: Deprecated function to get chart IDs within a filter scope, traverses component tree to find chart IDs.

methods.name: buildActiveFilters
methods.description: Constructs the active filters state from dashboard filters and components, updating internal caches.
